recoveredFacts: All three owner and three corresponding Typewriter skill prefab hierarchies, thirty ranks each, selected promotion/potential talents and six original projectile trees are retained. Typewriter has independent table stats, cost5, respawn40, block0, maxDeployCount1 and native slot occupancy0; owner finish kills owned tokens and token finish recharges stock.

Original owner Attack uses first-only Attack_Begin0.5 then Attack_Loop1.6 with OnAttack0.133333 in both facings. S1 Front Skill_1_Loop event is0.133333 while Back is0.3. S3 Begin0.666667 and Loop1 with OnAttack0.133333 are separate from End0.5. Original Typewriter Attack has OnAttack0.066667 and duration1.6 in both facings; Down-specific clips are preserved.

S1 uses attack-recovery automatic activation with unlimited duration, selected ATK increase and Dice(prob) followed by AtkScaleUp on calculated damage. Owner and Typewriter each retain their own bgsnow_s_1[random_atk] template and rank coefficients. Owner mode aura triggers the token skill; this is not an independently charging visible token control.

S2 owner and token each retain one Ranged projectile ability plus a serialized action graph containing two AdvancedApplyDamage executions via an explicit reference. Both attack graphs wait for their original single attack event; no additionalTimes or staggered multi-emission timer is serialized. Selected one-charge ranks1..3 and two-charge ranks4..10 plus skill range3-1 is retained separately from operator phase ranges2-3/3-6 and Typewriter default range3-2.

S2 owner skill owns a separate trigger_token_skill action. Token native blackboard copier applies the equipped owner respawn_time ratio only for skill index1, and its card modifier on finish lasts UNTIL_NEXT_SPAWN. The original finish/recharge/card-buff dispatch order is not recovered from the serialized fields alone.

S3 owner selected base_attack_time modifier and front-three-tile focus mark use separate damage templates. Focus check is source-specific; the ordinary coefficient is used when that mark is absent. Token gets selected attack@atk_scale and base_attack_time from its own ranks, switches to directional modes2/3 and restores modes0/1 on buff finish. Owner skill finish removes the matching token switch buff.

Typewriter talent lifetime is15/20/25s atE0/E1/E2 through a one-trigger withdrawal buff. AtE2 its calculated-damage listener checks owner adjacency mark, then applies separate prioritized FINAL_SCALER DEF debuffs:18%/23% for4s, or20%/25% for5s atpotential5. Adjacent eligibility uses original owner range x-5; base and stronger debuff keys are preserved independently.

Owner and Typewriter use two different original front/back skeletons each, with native FaceSwitchers. Token skeleton, atlas, material, RGB and separate alpha dependencies follow exact pointer chains; merged PNG pixels and normalized atlas are derived explicitly. Every homing projectile retains speed10, lifetime10, one-victim hit limit and independent source-invalidation fields.
runtimeContracts: All thirty owner ranks and thirty corresponding token ranks remain selected independently. Typewriter uses its own elite/level stats without owner trust/potential ATK transfer, raised-tile facing placement, cost5, block0 and zero deployment slots. Native category2 maps to an untargetable, invulnerable device excluded from ordinary healing/Inspiration; token skill wrappers expose no independent SP/control.

Owner ordinary Attack uses first-only Begin then Loop and resets its local engagement latch when no legal target remains. Ordinary animation speed is uncapped; skill/token animation speed caps at1. Original facing-specific OnAttack times, including S1 Back0.3 and Front0.133333, are retained. Typewriter Down uses its original distinct clips.

S1 automatically charges from owner attacks and remains active until removal. Owner and token apply their own selected ATK modifiers and independent Dice rolls at local output-damage calculation. Active-mode attachment reaches a newly deployed token; this bounded mapping does not infer an independently charging token skill.

S2 requires a legal owner victim in selected range3-1 before spending a charge. Owner and deployed token independently select one nearest legal victim. One original event emits one homing projectile whose impact produces a basic Physical receipt plus two same-target Physical BUFF receipts, each separately mitigated. Token extras suppress its source-calculation DEF trigger. No staggered emission offsets are invented.

S2 cast windows stop normal attacks and SP recovery, cancel unfired shots on accepted control/removal and permit already fired shots to complete. The token may have no victim independently. Each source uses its own ATK and original attack event; one/two owner charges follow ranks1..3/4..10.

S3 expands owner range, applies selected flat attack-interval reduction, and selects the front-focus or lateral coefficient from that owners facing geometry at damage calculation. Typewriter inherits the active mode, its own attack@atk_scale and interval reduction, and range4-1. Its hidden indefinite switch buff follows the owners skill end rather than the unused token skill-table20s duration.

Typewriter E2 calculated-damage applies separate prioritized FINAL_SCALER DEF holders before local mitigation, sampling current owner adjacency. Equal/weaker producers retain the stronger holder and extend its duration. Separate base/adjacent holders contribute only the strongest reduction; unrelated DEF modifiers compose and the weaker holder resumes after stronger expiry. Selected potential5 strength/duration is preserved.

Typewriter expires after selected15/20/25s or leaves early on retreat/owner removal. Finish restores one stock and begins its independent40s cooldown, multiplied by selected S2 respawn_time only when that skill is equipped. Owner redeployment preserves that clock. Explicit local finish/recharge ordering and stock caps prevent duplicate cards.
verificationLimits: S2 target/charge/extra-action dispatch, first-only Begin reset, source callback ordering and skill-bound token attachment are reviewed simulator contracts; serialized fields alone do not certify compiled native scheduling.

Focus and adjacency sample local output damage; strongest DEF holder selection, modifier timing, mode attachment and finish/recharge/card-buff order use deterministic local dispatch rather than certified native same-frame behavior.
Frame parity, modules and original Unity particles/audio remain separate work. Original facing art and simple authoritative arrow projectiles do not establish native VFX parity.
